changes.summary: When tf-export auto-resolves duplicate Terraform block labels for the same resource type, the appended suffix changes from _<numeric_hash> to _BRCM<numeric_hash>. Exported resource block names in this edge case will differ from v1.62.0 output.

Resource block label sanitization now returns an empty label when a resource name is empty or sanitizes to no valid characters, instead of failing during label processing. This applies to both the default sanitizer and the time-optimized sanitizer (GENESYS_SANITIZER_TIME_OPTIMIZED).

related_export_changes.summary: Exported resource block labels may be empty when a resource name is empty or sanitizes to no valid characters, instead of the export failing during label processing.
